title: Why are people saying GTA 6 is bad? The launch-day backlash
answer: Critics love GTA 6, which holds a 99 on Metacritic, but some players are complaining about its 30 fps frame rate on consoles, slower and more realistic missions, and harder car theft. Viral early-play posts, including a widely shared 2/10 verdict, turned those complaints into a meme on launch week.
body:
"GTA 6 is bad" is a launch-week argument, not a consensus. Grand Theft Auto VI arrived on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on Nov. 19, 2026, and before release it had a 99/100 Metacritic score from 147 critics, according to The National. But a vocal group of players say the game they waited 13 years for doesn't feel like GTA. You'll see the phrase used both sincerely and as bait: "GTA 6 is bad, I'm going back to GTA 5" gets plenty of replies.

The complaints fall into a few groups. Frame rate: the game targets 30 frames per second on consoles, which some reviewers, including TechRadar's, said may disappoint players used to 60. Pace: critics at Game Informer and Worthplaying described some missions as tightly scripted and the opening as slow, and players echo that with jokes that it feels like a life simulator with guns. Car theft: stealing cars is deliberately harder, since some drivers fight back and keyless cars can't simply be hotwired, which fans see as undercutting the series' trademark chaos. Reviewers also flagged clunky combat controls.

The backlash went viral on Nov. 18, when a gamer's post giving the game 2/10 after about four hours of early play spread widely, and other players pushed back that four hours is far too little to judge a story that reportedly takes around 80 hours. Separately, some buyers of boxed copies, which contain a download code instead of a disc, reported missing or already-used codes. Sony's support page tells affected buyers to contact their retailer.

What to know: most professional reviews are glowing, and many complaints come from early or partial playthroughs. If you're deciding whether to buy, the frame-rate and slower-pace criticisms are the ones reviewers and players agree on most.
in_the_news: Grand Theft Auto VI launched Nov. 19, 2026, and "why are people saying GTA 6 is bad" started climbing in Google suggestions the day before.

faq.a: Critics don't think so: it has a 99 on Metacritic. The complaints come mostly from players and focus on 30 fps, slower missions and harder car theft.
No. It targets 30 frames per second on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and performance varies between the standard PS5 and PS5 Pro.

faq.q: Can you still steal cars in GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes, but it's harder. Some drivers resist, locked cars may need a broken window, and keyless cars can't just be hotwired.

faq.q: Why are people calling off work for GTA 6?
faq.a: Because of launch day. Surveys reported in mid-November found nearly 1 in 5 workers planned to take Nov. 19 off to play.
